Describes disk storage, not atomic instructions or lock implementation.

grades.quote: ARM load-exclusive and store-exclusive instructions can likewise map onto their RISC-V LR and SC equivalents
grades.reason: Directly identifies RISC-V LR/SC as the analogue of ARM load-exclusive/store-exclusive.

grades.quote: RISC-V contains two types of atomics: AMOs and LR/SC pairs. These conceptually behave differently, in the following way. LR/SC behave as if the old value is brought up to the core, modified, and written back to memory, all while a reservation is held on that memory location.
grades.reason: Identifies and explains LR/SC, the reservation-based RISC-V mechanism corresponding to exclusive-load/store atomic updates.
